info.name: Robot rollout verifier Archive Verify API

items.docs:
Background twin of /api/h1 (mode=single) / /api/segment (mode=multi).

final=0 opens a STREAMING job: the browser adds videos via
/api/verify/add as each upload lands, so verification overlaps upload —
results stream out while later files are still in transit. plan_total is
the intended batch size, used only for progress display.

Feed more videos into a streaming job (and/or seal it with final=1 —
a seal-only call carries no files). Each add-group starts verifying
immediately; the job completes when sealed and every video delivered.

Verify ONE robot-rollout video against a task instruction (our h1
finetune).

Form fields: `task` (the instruction), `file` (the video), `frames`
(frames sampled, clamped 8-32).

Returns a single verdict: `"success"`, `"failure"`, or `null` (the model
gave no parseable answer). A video holding several sequential attempts
should instead go to POST /v1/batch with mode=multi.
